preview.tournamentOverview: TPC Southwind is a par-70, 7,244-yard course that places a premium on approach play and total strokes gained. The event is the first leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, awarding 2,000 FedExCup points and a $15 million purse. Strong ball-striking and bogey avoidance are rewarded on its narrow fairways and firm, undulating greens.
preview.modelExplainer: SG Approach 3%) and SG Total 0%) carry the heaviest weight, followed by SG Putting 5%) and SG Around-the-Green 0%). Driving Accuracy 2%) and Bogey Avoidance 0%) round out the model, emphasizing precision over distance. The weights tilt the model toward players who consistently hit greens and limit mistakes.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by model rank versus power rank gaps, targeting players whose SG profile aligns with the course weights. Tier 1 includes top-5 model names with positive SG App and SG Total; Tier 2 targets mid-tier risers with strong SG App or SG Putt. Exposure is capped at 5 units per golfer, with outrights and top-20 matchups prioritized.
